Russell and Norvig's Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach arranges them as a spectrum, from a bare reflex agent up to a learning agent that improves its own rules. This course starts with rigid logic, then adds a language model and engineered context to move toward a model-based, goal-oriented loop. Later modules keep that loop running over changing state, which is the pattern learning agents build on.

Two things that call is quietly doing, and why. Neither is magic, and both are worth understanding before you trust them.
  • Your request may go through a proxy. If you selected the learning management system/iframe setting when you put in your API key, your request does not hit build.nvidia.com directly. That endpoint does not return the cross-origin (CORS) headers a browser fetch requires, so the call is routed through a small pass-through proxy that adds them. The proxy also adds a course attribution header so DLI can identify traffic from this resource. The lesson sends your API key with that request without storing it or substituting another key.
  • Streaming is wrapped in a helper. chatStream() sends the same chat request with streaming enabled, then parses the returned event stream into answer text, reasoning text, usage metadata, and the final done signal. The helper also connects those pieces to the lesson panel and Stop button, so the cell can focus on the concept instead of the streaming plumbing. You can open the helper source from the cell menu to inspect exactly what it does.

rich.cea2b64a5fbd.source: All of them perceive their environment through sensors and act on it through actuators. Because each action feeds the next observation, perceiving and acting fold into one continuous cycle, a perceive-reason-act loop, that lasts as long as the agent continues to interact. The agents you will build all adopt the same cycle and are set apart only by how much they can perceive and how far their actions reach.
rich.cea2b64a5fbd.value: 它們都會透過感測器感知環境，並透過執行器對環境採取行動。每次行動都會產生下一次觀察，因此感知和行動會連成一個持續運轉的週期，即感知—推理—行動迴圈。只要代理程式仍在互動，這個迴圈就會持續。您將建置的所有代理程式都採用同一迴圈，區別僅在於它們能感知多少資訊，以及行動能夠影響多大範圍。

rich.d106759c1b2d.source: Locally-sample. Your code reads a slice of the environment, which might be the maze cell and its valid moves, or the latest user message, or the contents of a file. It never reaches for the whole world at once, because all the turn requires is the narrow piece of state the model needs to act on this time around.
rich.d106759c1b2d.value: 區域性取樣。程式碼讀取環境的一個區域性切片，例如迷宮中的當前單元格及其有效移動方向、最新的使用者訊息，或某個檔案的內容。它不會試圖一次獲取整個世界，因為當前這一輪只需要模型此次行動所需的那一小部分狀態。

rich.d362383be48a.source: Each pass of the loop acts only locally. The model reads one small piece of the world such as a single maze cell and hands back one bounded action before the stateless text-to-text step between them forgets everything it just saw. An agent that accomplishes a great deal is only this modest cycle repeated many times while the environment carries the state forward from one pass to the next. Module 1b builds that cycle in code where you can watch the context grow with each turn.
rich.d362383be48a.value: 迴圈的每一輪都只在區域性行動。模型讀取環境中的一小部分，例如一個迷宮單元格，然後傳回一個範圍受限的動作；兩者之間的無狀態文字到文字步驟隨即忘記剛才看到的一切。一個能夠完成大量工作的代理程式，本質上只是多次重複這個簡單迴圈，同時由環境將狀態從一輪傳遞到下一輪。模組 1b 將用程式碼建置這個迴圈，讓您看到上下文如何隨每輪執行而增長。

rich.d3689c04407c.source: A schema turns the answer into a typed action. The constant rule returned a string. BFS handed back a list. choose_direction gives the model the same contract but enforces it through a JSON Schema, so the loop reads a typed value instead of parsing free prose. With it, a language model can take the decision step that BFS and A* held a moment ago.
rich.d3689c04407c.value: 模式將回答轉換為型別化動作。固定規則傳回一個字串，BFS 傳回一個列表。choose_direction 為模型提供相同的契約，但透過 JSON Schema 強制執行該契約，使迴圈讀取型別化值，而不是解析自由文字。有了它，語言模型便可接管剛才由 BFS 和 A* 承擔的決策步驟。

text.b70882637398.source:
You are navigating a maze.
You are called only at JUNCTIONS (2+ open directions).
You get an ASCII map that marks walls, explored cells, your position, and the goal.
Corridors are auto-walked, so your position can jump several cells between calls.
Choose ONE direction from "Allowed moves this turn" and call choose_direction().
Do not repeat a direction listed under "Already tried here."
When every branch is exhausted, take the allowed backtrack and continue.
Prefer unvisited branches (-) over visited cells (·), and head toward G when you can see it.
Minimize reasoning efforts and make immediate moves.
